basis: Nordstrom’s May 31 earnings release was the earliest verified disclosure that established the threshold for fiscal Q1 2023. Its consolidated GAAP table reported total revenue of $3,181 million for the quarter ended April 29, 2023, versus $3,569 million for the quarter ended April 30, 2022. Revenue fell 10.87%, below the $3,390.55 million cutoff. The 2023 total comprised $3,064 million of net sales and $117 million of net credit card revenue. It included Canadian operations through March 2, their deconsolidation date. The comparison uses both quarters as reported.

coverage.detail: November 22, 2022, preceding earnings cycle. The fiscal Q3 release maintained the fiscal 2022 revenue outlook. Its guidance did not extend to fiscal Q1 2023.
The November 22 prepared remarks discussed softening demand and the outlook for the remainder of fiscal 2022. They gave no fiscal Q1 2023 revenue bound.
January 19, 2023. The 3.5% net-sales decline covered nine holiday weeks ended December 31, 2022. The updated revenue outlook applied to fiscal 2022.

March 2, 2023, immediately preceding earnings release. The 4%–6% revenue decline forecast covered all of fiscal 2023. The approximately $400 million Canadian net-sales impact was also annual. The $300 million–$350 million Q1 estimate measured pretax wind-down charges.

March 2 prepared remarks projected a low-double-digit revenue decline for the first half and low-single-digit growth for the second half. The first-half estimate combines Q1 and Q2 and supplies no upper bound for Q1 alone.

In the March 2 public call Q&A, the interim CFO discussed revenue by half. The comparison with 2019 described the two halves of fiscal 2022. Management’s quarter-specific breakeven forecast concerned Q1 EBIT.
April 17. The release announced Eric Sprunk’s board appointment and gave no Q1 revenue update.
May 10. The release announced Cathy Smith’s CFO appointment. Its historical revenue-growth reference concerned her former employer.

May 11. Nordstrom scheduled its Q1 results for May 31 after market close and provided no preliminary figures. Searches of issuer releases, investor presentations and public management remarks between March 2 and May 31 identified no earlier Q1 consolidated revenue bound.
May 17, filed May 22. The release announced a quarterly dividend of $0.19 per share and gave no Q1 revenue update.
May 31. Nordstrom published the Q1 GAAP revenue table. The headline 11.6% decline applied to net sales alone. Including net credit card revenues gives the 10.87% consolidated revenue decline.
EDGAR accepted the results 8-K with the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1 on May 31 at 16:34:56.
The June 7 Form 10-Q confirms the same quarterly revenue amounts and the March 2 Canadian deconsolidation.

publication_date_evidence: Nordstrom’s issuer-hosted Q1 earnings release carries a May 31, 2023 Seattle dateline. Its May 11 notice announced that publication date in advance, and EDGAR records same-day acceptance of the release as Exhibit 99.1.
